questions.q: Do you do any sports or exercise?
questions.answer: I try to, though not as consistently as I should. I go for a brisk walk most evenings, and occasionally I play badminton. I always feel [[rejuvenated]] afterwards, so I really ought to do more of it.

questions.q: Did you play any sports at school?
questions.answer: Yes, cricket was my main sport, and I played for my school team for a couple of years. I wasn't the most talented player, but I made up for it with [[sheer enthusiasm]], and it taught me a lot about teamwork.

questions.q: Do you prefer exercising alone or with other people?
questions.answer: It depends. For walking, I prefer being alone, because it gives me time to think. For something like badminton, though, company makes it far more enjoyable and keeps me [[accountable]], so I'm less likely to skip it.

questions.q: Do you have a healthy lifestyle?
questions.answer: Reasonably, I'd say. I eat home-cooked food most of the time and try to stay active, but my sleep could be better. It's an ongoing effort, but I think I'm gradually [[cultivating]] better habits.

questions.q: Are people in your country becoming more health-conscious?
questions.answer: Gradually, yes. You now see many people walking or jogging in parks early in the morning, which was rare before. There's a [[heightened awareness]] of diet too, although fast food is still hugely popular among young people.
